[SWS_UCM_00003] Cancelling the package processing
⌈
On call of Cancel method, UCM shall abort the running package processing task,
undo the changes to the Software Cluster for which processing started and free
the reserved resources used for it. The Processing State of a Software Package (
processingState) shall transition to kProcessingFailed.
⌋
